title: fix(pm): advisory_list admits the null dates the platform declares, and names the failing field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xSfXJYRX1ckSy1GzGhNKjDZ)_

Fixes #32217

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：relay 的 `advisory_list` 字段围栏现在接受平台声明可为 null 的 `created_at` / `updated_at`，其余越界值照旧拒绝；拒绝句改为点名失败的字段（从不带值）。
- 为什么改：run 42795023621 里平台已答 200，是 relay 自己的围栏拒绝了列表（exit 5），而平台 schema 把这两个日期声明为 nullable，围栏比它自称的"声明形状"更窄。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `scripts/pm/fleet-write/{ops,validate,execute}.mjs`，不发布任何包，不改 workflow、不改授权；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ops.mjs` 的 `ADVISORY_LIST_FIELD_SHAPES` / `advisoryListFieldSentence` / `advisoryListPageFailure`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` 与 `execute.mjs --self-test` 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无；合入后由席位经 relay 跑一次 `advisory_list` 作为验收。

## What changes

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`: the listing's page fence now judges each of `severity`, `created_at` and `updated_at` against `ADVISORY_LIST_FIELD_SHAPES`, which admits `null` for all three (it already did for `severity`), keeps refusing every other off-shape value and a field the advisory lacks, and names every failing field, by name and in that order, through `advisoryListFieldSentence`. The sentence never carries a value, an id, a state or a count. `validate.mjs` and `execute.mjs` pin both halves.

## Why

The measured cause, from run 42795023621's execute step (job 129757874215):

```
✗ action 1 advisory_list: GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/security-advisories?state={triage,draft,closed}&per_page=100 -> REFUSED at the relay's fence on the listing, nothing sealed or emitted — a page of the listing lists an advisory whose severity or dates are not of the field's declared shape
fleet-write/execute: ✗ stopped at action 1 (advisory_list); 0 later action(s) NOT attempted.
##[error]Process completed with exit code 5.
```

- The platform answered: the row carries no platform text and no access remedy, which `execute.mjs` appends only to a non-2xx answer, and the page passed the status, list, id and state fences. So the grant, the query, the mint and the token action's `permission-repository-advisories` warning are not the cause, and the platform refused nothing.
- The failing fence was the relay's own field fence. The platform's `repository-advisory` schema (github/rest-api-description) declares `created_at` and `updated_at` as `"format": "date-time", "nullable": true`, but the fence refused `null` for both, and `validate.mjs` pinned `created_at: null` as a refusal. The fence was narrower than the declared shape its own sentence names.
- The old sentence covered three fields, so the log cannot say which one tripped. A null date is the one value the platform declares that the fence refused; `severity` already admitted `null`. The new sentence names the field, so if the acceptance run still trips, its log says which field to measure.

## Verification

Self-test counts, before (origin/main 60b99f8fd) and after:

| self-test | before | after |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` | 375 cases, 19 batteries | 377 cases, 19 batteries |
| `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test` | 333 cases, 26 batteries | 334 cases, 26 batteries |
| `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` | 358 cases, 30 batteries | 358 cases, 30 batteries |

- `validate.mjs`: the field-fence case drops `created_at: null` from the refusals and now expects the per-field sentence; a new case holds null `created_at`, null `updated_at` and an all-null advisory, while a missing field still fails naming it; a new case pins that the refusal names every failing field in declared order and no value.
- `execute.mjs`: the field-fenced runs expect the per-field sentence (no `null` among them); a new run lands a listing whose advisories carry null dates and null severity, and the seat opens the nulls as answered. The battery's marker sweep counts that run (39 → 40 runs, no leak).
- Ablation: with null removed from the date shape on the committed fix, `validate.mjs` and `execute.mjs` each go red on the new case (1 failure each); restored, both green.
- Gates on head 62949003: `dispatch-gates --commands` (39 commands) and every command it lists, plus the three fleet-write self-tests and `check-commit-card-trailers`: 43 of 43 exit 0.

Acceptance run: the relay executes from `main`, so the acceptance `advisory_list` runs after this merges; its run id goes on the card.

Tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` reads 0 of 3 paths governed, and `dispatch-gates --tier` derives no path mandate. The maintainer's standing order waives a mandated tier for card threads; the seat runs any review of record.

Changeset: none (`skip-changeset`): `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing.
